children: Overview
Flooring and design surfaces maker's Q3 revenue up 1%, a slight miss versus analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS for Q3 rose 2%, beating analyst expectations
Company returned $261 mln to shareholders, authorized new $500 mln buyback
Outlook
Mohawk expects Q4 2026 adjusted EPS of $1.35 to $1.45
Company expects low single-digit growth in Q4 2026 adjusted net sales versus prior year
Mohawk assumes Q4 2026 flooring market conditions will be softer than Q3
Result Drivers
PRICE INCREASES - Co said price increases in response to inflation contributed to sales growth
SOFT DEMAND - Co said volumes declined due to weak market demand
PRODUCTIVITY GAINS - Co said productivity improvements helped offset higher inflation
